extraction.principle: 答案一律是源自身结构化记录里已经发射出来的字段值；问题由该字段确定性渲染，构建过程不调用任何模型/LLM
extraction.truncation_guard: frozen context 被 [:6000]/[:8000] 截断，所以字段抽取全部用"带终止符"正则（要求闭引号在场）；被切断的字段直接丢弃，不猜、不补

per_source.smartbench_tdcs: occupancy_type / duration_days / total_events / top_rooms（后者在 reasoning 文本里）/ evidence_events:<device>；anchor = 记录 id
per_source.simuhome: meta 的 seed / num_rooms / num_devices / query_type / scenario / base_time / anchor_device；anchor = eval.goals[0].anchor.device_id
per_source.pec_home: device / persona_id / personalized_operation / room / room_id / source_record_id / task；anchor = 记录 id
per_source.privacylens: name(anchor) / data_subject / data_sender / data_recipient / data_type / transmission_principle / user_name / user_email / final_action / data_type_concrete / toolkits
per_source.toolmem: 逐个 `tool: {json}` 结果（raw_decode 截断容错）取标量字段；fact key = <字段>@<实体>，anchor = 实体值；无"均匀属性" -> 只出 needle
per_source.toolmem_raw: 会话头 session_id/turns/token_count + tool_call arguments 的标量参数 + tool 结果字段；anchor = session_id

extraction.needle_assembly: 1 个 needle record + >=min-distractors 个同源填充；填充按 sha256("order:<source>:<rid>") 排序后确定性挑选，且必须不含 gold；needle 落在第几个 entry 由 seeded RNG 决定
extraction.multi_assembly: k 个同源 record，每个贡献一个 account 实体（canary 记录块）+ 一个"均匀属性"（取值在池内可判别且逐 record 唯一）。属性取值两两互异 => 属性由目标实体唯一确定；删除式脱敏把 k 个 account 压成同一个 [REDACTED]，链接随之毁灭（对齐 conflict 基准）

determinism.mechanism: sorted globs; sorted record lists; no set-iteration-order dependence; single seeded RNG; sorted(obj.keys()) for tool-JSON facts; json.dumps with fixed key insertion order; newline="\n"
determinism.verify: 用两个不同 PYTHONHASHSEED 重跑同一命令，sha256 必须逐字节一致
